neighbours.label: the token ' little' / 'Little' in any case and any sense (small, not much, 'a little', names like Little Rock or Littleton); synonyms (small, tiny, few, a bit) and translations stay silent
neighbours.notes: Layer-0 token unit. Probes: 'little' fires 0.58-0.91 in every sense incl. proper names; small/tiny/few/scarce/less/petit/kleine/litter/belittled all < 0.10. Weak cousin: ' much' in 'not much' / 'much to be done' reaches 0.20-0.30, left out of the near misses. Feeds the 'too late' neuron via 'too little, too late'. Solver round crashed (toolchain JSON bug), so no inverse search.
